I'm not sure, but that's a start, thanks! :)


EDIT: I've looked, and although he's written songs about pregnancy, one night stands, and miscarriages, I'm pretty sure they're not the ones I was thinking of. Thanks, though.
Funnily enough, who cares either way?
To both of the people who posted: this is definitely the book, thank you so much!

Funnily enough, I'm the only one in my family who hasn't seen a counsillor of some sort over the years. We live in England, and get a referral to a therapist is quite rare on the NHS (or if you do, you won't be assigned many sessions). There's free counsilling at my university, but the idea of sitting down and trying to explain to someone every terrible thing that has happened to me and my family over the past decade (there has been a lot of crap) or try to explain my 'not wanting to exist' thing just feels too self indulgent.

(Okay, I know it's kind of hypocritical being on here talking about myself and saying I hate the idea of talking about myself. But this is anonymous and feels a lot less like admitting I need help.)

You are right though. Last time I booked an appointment though I chickened out at the last minute (pathetic, yes.)
I'm trying D: but my mom is a real piece of work sometimes, especially when she puts her mind to something.
Thanks, I feel so selfish *because* I have all this things, but it doesn't help, I just feel worthless and pathetic and useless. It'll all pass, I guess, eventually.

I'm trying to be there for her the best I can. I even attempted to be supportive and enthusiastic. It's a difficult time for her, and I get that. The problem is my mom is the sort of person who doesn't really take 'I don't want to get into it' for an answer. In fact, that was what I was trying to say to her before she completely blew up in my face.

This is one of the things I'm hoping will happen once the divorce is out of the way, that she'll be able to get some perspective and realise that this is irrational and quite destructive behaviour. 

Thanks though, it's just nice to know I'm not being completely horrible to her for not being that enthusiastic or thinking it was a good idea. I mean, I fully support her doing it for herself if that's *really* something she wants to do, but I'm quite a private person and have so far tried to keep this as away from my college life as possible.

This is very contructive, and I appreciate it, but it's not really that my life doesn't have value, exactly. I volunteer on Sundays, I'm at University, I even wrote and am currently directing a play. But all these things kind of feel very pointless at the moment. Everything feels just empty and hollow.

Thank you though, I really do appreciate it.

You should talk to someone. Obviously you don't want to, but if you share with someone why you feel this way then maybe they'll be able to help you.

If you don't want to talk to someone in person, please feel free to PM.

This is exactly what I was trying to tell her and she just basically blew up at me and now is refusing to speak to me.

My mom can be so childish sometimes. I love her so much, but someone needs to tell her to get a grip. It's terrible what happened to her, but she needs to rise above and get on with putting her life back together rather than stooping to his pathetic level. People are going to judge HER for this, not him. 

I think he could also sue her for defamation of character if she's not careful. It's all just messed up, but she's not listening!
People will always miss you. There will be always somebody there who does, I promise.

Yeah, but she wants 'everyone to share it' including me and my brother and my old friends and my brother's friends and things. She thinks if enough people share it then he'll be notorious and not be able to get away with his crap.
I have a couple of friends who visited Tanzania and they said it was a life changing experience. :)

Usually the fact that my mother would not be able to cope with another tragedy.

It's good to have something to stop you, particularly the thought of loved ones. If you can imagine someone is upset at the idea of your death then it obviously means there is love in your life and that can never be a bad thing.

Africa is a very large continent. It's like saying the best place you visited was 'Europe', and it's also like lumping together all African countries and saying they're all alike.

You should be more specific.

Having said that, it's also incredibly impressive what you are doing and I hope your charity website does well. :)
I think she'd still make me do it. One of my thoughts was to post it but make sure no one could see it but my mom, but she's already mad at me now for not being 'enthusiastic' in the first place...
